caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular metallic structure with a semicircular or oval-shaped top, which has a small circular hole near its upper center. The metal is depicted in a muted grey color with various patches and streaks of brown and rust, giving it a weathered and aged appearance. At the base of the vertical structure, there is a round, shallow, rusted tray supporting it. Placed on the tray in front of the vertical panel is a small, cylindrical jug or pitcher, which is pale yellow in color with a brown base and a dark handle. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional details or objects present. The drawing includes a signature and a date, "Jacob Golden 1932," written in small, neat text at the bottom center.
title: Sconce
